purpose: Teach: 稀/読み方/目先/義父/うるさく/柔らかい/恥ずかしく/嫁さん

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、稀、絶対、な、絶対、お話、絶対、聞いたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Gran, do you remember? When you were young, your father told me stories I've never forgotten.
lines.style: Soft, searching tone. Gentle opening—reaching back through decades. Slow, deliberate pace. Let the memory settle in each phrase. A man revisiting something precious and fragile.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お地名の、絶対、読み方、絶対、よくお調べになったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, I do. Your grandfather was so careful about those place names, wasn't he? Always looking things up.
lines.style: Warm recollection, almost pleased with herself for remembering. Affectionate address. Gentle rhythm, like turning pages in an old album. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、目先、絶対、のことより、絶対、将来、絶対、考えてくれたぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: He thought about the future more than what was right in front of him. Do you remember that about him?
lines.style: Quieter now, more inward. A note of admiration underneath. Pause before 'future'—it carries weight. Trailing off slightly, as if the memory is pulling him somewhere distant.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お父さんの、絶対、義父、絶対、を、絶対、敬っていらしたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Yes, and your grandfather—he respected your father so much. The way he deferred to him. Do you recall?
lines.style: Nodding along with the past. Affectionate certainty. Slightly faster than before, animated by the memory. 'Respected' lands with quiet pride in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、うるさく、絶対、なる、絶対、夜、絶対、心配されたわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Late nights when the shop got loud and busy, you worried about me. You remember that, don't you?
lines.style: Voice softens further. Confession-like quality—vulnerability disguised as a question. Slow, almost hesitant. A man surprised by his own tenderness as he speaks.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お肉、絶対、柔らかい、絶対、煮込み、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes, and you loved that tender stewed meat I used to make. You always asked for it.
lines.style: Brightens slightly—this memory brings her joy. Housewifely pride and affection blended. A touch quicker, warmer. 'Loved' carries a small lift of satisfaction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さんに、絶対、恥ずかしく、絶対、お話、絶対、なさったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: You were shy about saying certain things to your father. But you trusted me with them.
lines.style: Voice drops to something more intimate. A knowing tone—no judgment, only understanding. Deliberate, careful phrasing. The cadence of someone protecting a secret they're honored to keep.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お兄ちゃんの、絶対、嫁さん、絶対、迎えてお喜びだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: And you were so happy when your brother brought home his wife. Do you remember how you welcomed her?
lines.style: Closing warmth. Brightness returns. A touch of mischief—she's bringing him home through these memories. Gentle and sure. Ends with quiet certainty, like she's wrapping something precious.
